collection_method: Public, logged-out access to Hillbarn's own Facebook and Instagram accounts. No logins, no accounts created.
license_status: All assets © Hillbarn or their commissioned photographers. Collected for brand research and internal mock-up only. NOT cleared for public launch. Original files or written permission required from Hillbarn before go-live.
